records.purpose: Create a unified longitudinal imaging environment for pediatric kidney and urinary tract disease.
records.scope: Imaging owns attributed thyroid/dermoscopy/urinary/musculoskeletal/ocular studies and longitudinal comparisons; electrophysiology and clinical findings retain their own acquisition context. Right and left eye, site, study/frame, modality and report version stay distinct. Imported images cannot become patient-derived anatomy without verified linkage and transform provenance. Source-specific scope: Pediatric Kidney & Urinary Imaging Intelligence Module
records.workflow: Use authorized versioned source context → produce the bounded pediatric-imaging-longitudinal-profiles artifact → retain clinician/operator attribution and source versions → expose only permitted views → retain corrections and invalidate dependent artifacts.
inputs: Authorized patient/tenant/purpose and profile-specific source facts
records.clinical_safety: No autonomous diagnosis, prescribing, dose/ventilator/pump change, emergency disposition or clinical-fact overwrite. Preserve REPORTED, OBSERVED, MEASURED, CLINICIAN_ASSESSED, INFERRED, PREDICTED and SIMULATED separately. Uncertain or incomplete evidence cannot become normality, eligibility or remission.
records.privacy: Per-record/encounter tenant, actor, purpose, age/assent/guardian authority, jurisdiction, restriction, expiry and revocation checks apply to views, exports, caches and downstream AI. Family/genomic and restricted session information is separately segmented; routine logs contain opaque IDs and hashes.
records.failure_modes: Reject identity/unit/schema/context-version conflicts with explicit unavailable/partial state; quarantine untrusted input. Retries use stable source event IDs and idempotency keys; corrections preserve history. Invalidate dependent artifacts on source, permission or model changes. Human clinical care never waits for a model.
records.acceptance: Preserve every original clause, patient/tenant/source/version/time provenance and explicit missingness. Test wrong identity, stale measurements, revoked consent, guardian changes, adolescent confidentiality and source corrections. Pediatric age, developmental stage, weight/height/unit/time and clinical context remain explicit where applicable. No automatic diagnosis, prescription, dose change, medication stop, device actuation or crisis disposition; qualified clinician review remains required. Clinical validation and production acceptance remain external gates.
records.open_gates: Inherit all existing owner readiness gates; source-profile contract/schema mappings, operational evidence, qualified clinical sign-off and end-to-end acceptance remain outstanding.

A measured, reported or model-estimated value remains labelled with source and time; estimates such as VO2 max are not direct measurements. Family roles do not grant unrestricted access, settings cannot override source security, and search results independently authorize every item. Provider listing is not credential verification. Source-specific scope: Pediatric Timeline
records.workflow: Use authorized versioned source context → produce the bounded core-profile-and-directory-projections artifact → retain clinician/operator attribution and source versions → expose only permitted views → retain corrections and invalidate dependent artifacts.
inputs: Authorized patient/tenant/purpose and profile-specific source facts
records.clinical_safety: No autonomous diagnosis, prescribing, dose/ventilator/pump change, emergency disposition or clinical-fact overwrite. Preserve REPORTED, OBSERVED, MEASURED, CLINICIAN_ASSESSED, INFERRED, PREDICTED and SIMULATED separately. Uncertain or incomplete evidence cannot become normality, eligibility or remission.
records.privacy: Per-record/encounter tenant, actor, purpose, age/assent/guardian authority, jurisdiction, restriction, expiry and revocation checks apply to views, exports, caches and downstream AI. Family/genomic and restricted session information is separately segmented; routine logs contain opaque IDs and hashes.
records.failure_modes: Reject identity/unit/schema/context-version conflicts with explicit unavailable/partial state; quarantine untrusted input. Retries use stable source event IDs and idempotency keys; corrections preserve history. Invalidate dependent artifacts on source, permission or model changes. Human clinical care never waits for a model.
records.acceptance: Preserve every original clause, patient/tenant/source/version/time provenance and explicit missingness. Test wrong identity, stale measurements, revoked consent, guardian changes, adolescent confidentiality and source corrections. Pediatric age, developmental stage, weight/height/unit/time and clinical context remain explicit where applicable. No automatic diagnosis, prescription, dose change, medication stop, device actuation or crisis disposition; qualified clinician review remains required. Clinical validation and production acceptance remain external gates.
records.open_gates: Inherit all existing owner readiness gates; source-profile contract/schema mappings, operational evidence, qualified clinical sign-off and end-to-end acceptance remain outstanding.
